goal: Make PostToolUseFailure RCA routing semantically meaningful by adding a thin adapter that maps Claude Code native failure hook payloads into the repeated-blocker schema.

governance/blocker_ledger/post_tool_fail.description: Adapter that maps {tool_name, tool_input, tool_response, ...} to blocker schema, then calls repeated_blocker_guard.classify(). Handles PASS_THROUGH (already adapted), MAPPED, and UNMAPPABLE (REVIEW_UNMAPPED_PAYLOAD) cases. Exit 0 on LOG_ONLY/LOG_NEW_VARIANT/REVIEW_UNMAPPED_PAYLOAD, exit 2 on FORCE_RCA.

design_decisions.normalized_command_structural_only: normalized_command (an identity fingerprint field) is built from tool_name + structural/path fields only (target_path, path, file_path, filepath, url, pattern). Free-text fields (query, content, etc.) are excluded so that different query strings targeting the same path produce the same identity fingerprint. Variability in free-text inputs is captured exclusively in input_digest.
design_decisions.fingerprint_identity_vs_variant: Identity fingerprint: 5 structural fields (blocker_type, component, operation, normalized_command, target_path). Variant fields: input_digest, evidence_digest. Same fingerprint + changed variants → LOG_NEW_VARIANT. Same fingerprint + same variants → FORCE_RCA.
design_decisions.unmappable_exit_0: Payloads without tool_name and without blocker schema fields yield REVIEW_UNMAPPED_PAYLOAD, exit 0. PostToolUseFailure is a notification hook (tool already failed); fail-closed would block the session unhelpfully.
design_decisions.pass_through_path: If payload already contains all FINGERPRINT_FIELDS, it bypasses mapping and routes directly to classify(). Enables direct injection of pre-adapted events in tests and by future callers.

hard_constraints_respected: Did not start full chat_export_mining cartridge
Did not claim native MetaBlooms OS source patching in this repo
Did not use file_search for mounted /mnt/data OS artifact truth
Did not bypass or remove the PreToolUse guard
Did not proceed beyond one bounded stage
limitations: Ledger is per-filesystem: recurrence is not tracked across machines or ephemeral containers
normalized_command heuristic excludes dynamic fields (query, content, text); a tool with no path-like inputs may produce normalized_command equal to the bare tool_name, making fingerprint coarser
Session ID is stored as provenance (_session_id) but not used in fingerprint; cross-session recurrence is tracked by structural identity only
PostToolUseFailure is notification-only (exit code not observed by Claude Code); FORCE_RCA exit 2 is recorded in the receipt but does not block the session
